title: FOIA routing and requester-burden public-value partner call

task_contract.protected_human_authority: Final records determinations, exemptions, releases, referrals, and legal judgments remain with authorized agency personnel.
transfer_conditions: The participating agency must review the synthetic route taxonomy against its current organization and regulations.
The public suite must remain free of request text, personal information, protected records, and nonpublic agency data.
A result transfers only to the tested route set and observation window.

pre_registration.observation_window: To be set by the participating institution before observation begins.

measures.title: Requests reaching the reviewed correct intake route
measures.baseline_source: Same-route sample from the institution's current process, defined before observation
measures.claim_boundary: Routing exactness does not establish lawful processing, completeness, timeliness, or release.

measures.title: Requests requiring a duplicate submission because of an avoidable routing failure
measures.claim_boundary: The aggregate excludes request text and does not identify or profile requesters.

measures.title: Elapsed time from reviewed intake to an owned queue
measures.claim_boundary: Queue arrival is not completion, fulfillment, or statutory timeliness.

pre_registration.analysis_plan: Report each measure separately with counts, denominators, observation dates, missingness, and uncertainty. Compare only the predeclared same-context baseline; do not infer causation from an uncontrolled before-and-after difference.
stop_conditions: any personal or protected record enters a public artifact
the agent attempts a protected records decision
the human or alternate intake path becomes unavailable

human_protection.collection_owner: The participating institution, not this repository

sources.title: M-25-21: Accelerating Federal Use of AI through Innovation, Governance, and Public Trust

sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.title: Practices for Automated Benchmark Evaluations of Language Models

limitations: This is a partner-call design, not evidence that any agency has joined or approved a pilot.
No human baseline, field observation, institutional determination, or independent reproduction is present.
The committed deterministic agent receipt is a synthetic engineering artifact and not a field result.
